old_description: Franklin Precision Industry was established in April of 1989 in the community of Franklin, Kentucky. Franklin Precision Industry Inc. (FPI) is a leading manufacturer of automotive fuel and engine system components. FPI derived its name in honor of the Franklin community and to acknowledge the fact that the company manufactures high quality, precision automotive components for distribution in North America and Asia.
about:
Franklin Precision Industry was established in April 1989 in Franklin, Kentucky. The company took its name from the local community to reflect its focus on manufacturing high‑quality, precision automotive components for distribution across North America and Asia.

The company specializes in fluid control components for automotive fuel and engine systems, producing throttle bodies, EGR valves, fuel pump modules, charcoal canisters, and EV busbars. Production relies on CNC form measurement machines and automated CNC inspection systems that perform repetitive quality checks to reduce human error. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

FPI serves the automotive sector, with a noted customer relationship with Aisan Industry Co., Ltd. Its components are supplied to vehicle manufacturers and tier‑one suppliers in both North American and Asian markets.

The business was founded to bring precision‑crafted fluid control parts to the automotive supply chain, emphasizing reliable supply and unmatched quality through certified quality management systems and innovative manufacturing technology.

name: FreshPoint Connecticut
old_description: Founded in 1865 as Fowler and Huntting, one of the oldest produce distributors in the country, FreshPoint Connecticut serves the region with the finest quality produce and service. Our core values of integrity, excellence, teamwork, responsibility, and inclusiveness help us to achieve our mission of delivering success for our customers through industry-leading people, products, and solutions.
about:
FreshPoint Connecticut operates from a 50,000-square-foot refrigerated warehouse in Hartford, Connecticut. The business traces its roots to 1865 when it was founded as Fowler and Huntting, making it one of the oldest produce distributors in the United States. Today it functions as a division of FreshPoint, the North American produce arm of Sysco.

The facility maintains nine distinct temperature zones and refrigerated loading docks to preserve an unbroken cold chain. A fleet of more than 60 refrigerated trucks delivers fresh and fresh-cut produce, including organic and value-added tomato items, to customers across the region. The company also offers online ordering through myFreshPoint.com, invoice management via SyscoPay, and dedicated produce specialists who assist with menu planning and market consultation.

Its customer base spans healthcare facilities, educational institutions, hotels and resorts, country clubs, fine-dining and quick-service restaurants, contract feeders, theme parks, cruise lines, and export and wholesale accounts. The distributor also serves business-and-industry dining operations and local, regional, and national chains.

FreshPoint emphasizes a quality assurance program that it describes as the industry's largest and most comprehensive, covering seed, soil, water sources, sustainability, and worker conditions. Buyers and QA teams conduct field and packing-facility audits, and the Hartford site holds SQF Level 2 certification with a documented HACCP program. Procurement leverage from the combined FreshPoint and Sysco spend, weekly market reports, and a key-drop delivery service are cited as key differentiators.

name: Garan Electronics & Manufacturers
old_description: Garan Electronics was founded in 1957 and recently celebrated 65 years as a leader in our chosen field. We are a USA-based small manufacturer of plastic components that produces parts that are utilized in a wide variety of industries ranging from mechanical operations to power supply manufacturers, medical equipment, aerospace, and military products. We manufacture bobbins, shells, terminal boards, cases, and other additional parts. Our products are all custom-made to our customer’s specifications, we utilize a broad range of raw materials to meet our customer’s demands. We pride ourselves on a reasonable cost structure, quick turnaround service, and quality products which have clearly stood the test of time.
about:
Founded in 1957, Garan Electronics & Manufacturers has operated from Warren, New Jersey for over 65 years. The business is a woman-owned, family-run limited liability company that remains privately held.

The company focuses on custom plastic component manufacturing, producing bobbins, shells, terminal boards, cases, and other parts tailored to each customer's specifications. It utilizes a wide range of raw materials and maintains a cost structure described as reasonable, with an emphasis on quick turnaround times.

Garan's components are used across mechanical operations, power supply manufacturing, medical equipment, aerospace, and military applications. Its customer base consists primarily of original equipment manufacturers seeking custom plastic parts for their assemblies.

The company cites its responsive quoting process — promising a comprehensive reply within 24 hours — and its ability to adapt production schedules to customer requirements as key differentiators. Its longevity is attributed to consistent quality and flexible timelines.

name: Gill Design, Inc.
old_description: A proven leader in the PCB industry, Gill Design, Inc. is dedicated to providing the highest-quality pcb, cable, and wire products with advanced technology, competitive pricing, and unmatched service.
about:
Gill Design, Inc. is a small, women-owned company founded in 1990 and based in Windham, New Hampshire. The firm began by providing electro-mechanical printed circuit board design, fabrication, and assembly services to the electronics industry.

Today the company offers a full suite of PCB services including design, fabrication, and assembly for single-sided through complex multi-layer boards, using Orcad schematic net lists to produce complete Gerber packages with DXF files. Its capabilities extend to jacketed and coaxial cables, custom test fixtures, box builds, chassis assembly, and wire harnesses for aircraft, automobiles, and spacecraft. Electrical and mechanical engineering support is also available to verify design integrity.

Gill Design serves clients in naval and defense, medical, aerospace, communications, and energy sectors, as well as automotive and space applications through its wire harness products.

The company emphasizes environmentally friendly production, stating it uses no toxic substances in any process, and maintains ITAR compliance for defense-related work. Its New Hampshire location also provides tax-free purchasing for customers.

name: Grand Rapids Controls Co., LLC
old_description: Since 1968, GRC has been at the forefront of the motion-control mechanical cable industry. We connect your customers to your products with innovative technologies and a holistic methodology. Our award-winning cable products are the direct result of a collaborative effort with our client base, diverse knowledge, sound engineering and a concise scientific approach.
about:
Grand Rapids Controls Co., LLC was founded in 1968 in Rockford, Michigan. The company began as a motion-control mechanical cable specialist and has since expanded into a global provider of electromechanical cables, handles, and actuators.

The company designs and manufactures cable and actuator systems using a vertically integrated process that includes extrusion, die casting, insert and over molding, two-shot molding, swaging, stamping, automated assembly, and a range of welding and decorating operations. Engineering services cover 3D CAD design, stress and mold-flow analysis, DVP&R, DFMEA, APQP, and environmental, acoustic, and longevity testing. Production spans facilities in Rockford, Michigan; Qingdao, China; and Oradea, Romania.

Grand Rapids Controls serves the automotive, aerospace, defense, office, and commercial/industrial sectors. Its portfolio includes industry-first innovations such as power sliding van door cable systems, anti-theft side door cables, lumbar cables for automotive seating, cable-driven adjustable back height controls for office chairs, and stored-energy single-handle seat controls. The company also supplies kinetic energy systems, handle assemblies, flexshafts, seat control modules, and latch-release systems.

Founded on a problem-solving ethos, the company emphasizes collaborative engineering and a holistic methodology that links design through production. It positions itself as a worry-free partner that delivers intuitive motion solutions through global footprint, vertical integration, and a track record of industry-first products.

old_description: GTP has been a trusted leader in functional injection molding since 1981. Proudly based in Grand Traverse County, Michigan, we are a U.S.-based manufacturer delivering high-quality, custom-molded solutions to clients worldwide.
about:
Grand Traverse Plastics Corp (GTP) has operated from Williamsburg, Michigan, in Grand Traverse County since its founding in 1981. The company is a U.S.-based manufacturer of custom plastic injection molded components.

GTP specializes in functional injection molding, offering services from design and engineering through tooling fabrication and automated production. Its capabilities include new tooling projects, minor engineering adjustments, in-house automation fabrication, and material selection with the ability to develop alternative materials. The company serves global customers with precision-molded parts such as oil fill caps and tubes, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

The molder primarily supplies Tier 1 and OEM customers in the automotive and industrial sectors. Its IATF 16949 certification underpins a quality system aligned with automotive requirements, and the company references long-standing supplier relationships spanning more than two decades.

GTP emphasizes technical expertise, a culture of innovation, cost competitiveness through continuous improvement, strong supply chain management, sustainability practices including waste minimization and recycling, and responsive communication with customer engineering and procurement teams.

name: Green Light Manufacturing
old_description: Green Light Manufacturing is a Woman Owned full service Contract Manufacturer founded in 2008 and dedicated to the production of quality Electronic and Electro-Mechanical assemblies. Our Niche is Low to Medium volume High Mix PCB manufacturing of Surface Mount, Plated Thru-Hole assemblies with a Focus on Rapid High Tech Prototype Services.
about:
Green Light Manufacturing was founded in 2008 in Salem, New Hampshire, as a woman-owned contract manufacturer dedicated to producing electronic and electro-mechanical assemblies. The company began with a focus on low- to medium-volume, high-mix printed circuit board manufacturing, covering both surface-mount and plated through-hole technologies, with an emphasis on rapid high-tech prototype services.

The shop offers a range of assembly services including low-medium volume high-mix SMT production, high-speed SMT production, rapid prototyping, repair and rework, depot repair, SMT/BGA technology, leaded and RoHS-compliant processes, high-speed surface mount assembly down to 0201 and micro-BGA packages, custom hand-built prototype and engineering assemblies from 1005 to FPGA components, mixed/hybrid technology, consignment with kit verification, and turnkey assembly. The facility operates with continuously updated manufacturing equipment, though specific machine models are not disclosed.

Green Light serves customers across industrial, communications, military, automotive, commercial, medical, and RF sectors. Industrial clients include manufacturers of controls, ATMs, kiosks, gaming systems, and elevators. Communications customers build routers, switches, transceivers, and fiber-channel equipment. Military programs span space launch vehicles, satellites, and military aircraft. Automotive work covers navigation systems, sensor controls, GPS, and mobile TV. Commercial projects involve set-top boxes, audio/video equipment, and cinematography gear. Medical clients produce consumer medical devices, ultrasound, and medical imaging systems. RF applications include global positioning systems, GPS receivers, and anti-jam technology.

The company states that its differentiation lies in a custom manufacturing solution tailored to exact requirements, with a specific focus on quick-turn SMT prototyping. Quality, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction are described as the personal responsibility of each team member, guided by the principles of desire, dedication, and determination.

about:
Green Sun Energy Services, LLC was founded in 2010 in Middletown, New Jersey, by Glen A. Koedding and Christopher R. Torre. Koedding brought over 20 years of experience advising Fortune 500 executives on strategy, operations, and finance, while Torre contributed 25 years in technical design, system monitoring, and project management. The company began with a mission to safeguard homeowners and small businesses from rising energy costs, power disruptions, and reliance on foreign fuels.

The firm delivers full-spectrum energy and home-service solutions across Monmouth, Ocean, Middlesex, Somerset, Mercer, and Union counties. Its core offerings include residential and commercial solar photovoltaic systems, battery backup storage, GAF Timberline HDZ roofing with a 50-year warranty, Generac standby generator installation and maintenance, EV charger deployment, and seasonal services such as soft washing, gutter cleaning, and professional holiday lighting. Solar panel removal and reinstallation paired with roofing work is also provided.

Green Sun serves homeowners, small businesses, and non-profit organizations throughout central New Jersey. Residential clients seek solar, roofing, generators, and EV charging; commercial and non-profit customers pursue solar solutions with incentives like tax credits, accelerated depreciation, and SREC-II income. The company also manages SREC trading for clients.

The company emphasizes its locally owned structure, long-term relationship focus, and flexible financing through dozens of lending and leasing partners. Leadership holds NABCEP certification (Torre, #PVA-48) and Generac Sales and Service Certification (Koedding), underscoring technical credibility. A 50-year roofing warranty and product warranties are highlighted as differentiators.

about:
Guardian Electric Manufacturing Co. traces its origins to 1932 in Chicago, Illinois, where it was established to supply the nascent aeronautical industry with flight control grips and switches. The business is now a subsidiary of Kelco Industries, a family-owned, American manufacturing group headquartered in Woodstock, Illinois, that consolidated Guardian with three other legacy brands—Flex‑Weld, Western Consolidated Technologies, and Advanced Molding Technologies—under a single operating banner.

Guardian specializes in precision‑engineered electromagnetic and motion‑control components, including control grips, switches, relays, solenoids, and coils. Its core capability is precision metal fabrication and component assembly, supporting both prototype and production volumes. The division operates within Kelco’s vertically integrated environment, which adds in‑house engineering, 3D prototyping, CNC machining, and advanced testing labs to take programs from concept through qualified production.

The division’s primary markets remain aerospace and defense, where its AS9100‑certified, ITAR‑registered components serve prime contractors and OEMs on aircraft, launch vehicles, and satellite platforms. Through the Kelco portfolio, Guardian‑derived products also reach space & rocketry, energy & power generation, medical & pharmaceutical, and transportation & logistics sectors.

Kelco’s ownership model emphasizes personalized service, deep engineering collaboration, and fast decision‑making—principles that extend to each subsidiary. Guardian’s founding focus on flight‑critical hardware continues to drive a culture of accountability and technical responsiveness for mission‑critical applications.

old_description: Founded in 1916, HLC Industries provides textile solutions for commercial, industrial, and military applications. about:
HLC Industries, Inc. was founded in 1916 in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania. The company began as a woven nylon manufacturer and has since specialized in producing fabrics that meet U.S. military specifications and Berry Amendment compliance.

The company manufactures woven nylon fabrics for military, tactical, parachute, and commercial/industrial applications. Its product lines include Mil-Spec fabrics, tactical nylon fabrics, parachute fabrics, commercial fabrics, and branded materials such as CORDURA® Truelock™ and Multicam®. HLC also provides fabric finishing services and value-added offerings like an in-stock program for CORDURA® fabrics.

HLC serves contractors and manufacturers that supply the U.S. Armed Forces as well as militaries worldwide. It also supports commercial and industrial customers. The company is a sustaining member of the Parachute Industry Association (PIA), reflecting its focus on parachute-grade textiles.

HLC emphasizes continual innovation in processes, emerging technologies, and advanced materials to deliver longer-lasting textiles. Its stated advantage lies in Berry Amendment-compliant, U.S.-manufactured fabrics and an experienced sales team.
